headline: Asthma + Lung UK welcomes Tobacco and Vapes Act as it nears entry into force
dek: The charity said the Act, in force from 1 January 2027, means anyone born on or after 1 January 2009 will never be legally sold tobacco.
body:
Asthma + Lung UK has welcomed the Tobacco and Vapes Act, which it said will come into force in 42 days.

In a LinkedIn post published on 19 November 2026, the charity said that from 1 January 2027 anyone born on or after 1 January 2009 will never be legally sold tobacco. It described the change as "a historic step towards a smokefree generation".

The organisation said it welcomes the legislation and the difference it will make in protecting future generations from the harms of smoking. It called the Act a major public health achievement and a significant step towards creating a smokefree and vape-free society.
key_quote: a historic step towards a smokefree generation
